newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS says strike to delay Thursday flights.
newsitem.headline: SAS says strike to delay Thursday flights.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Thursday that it expected delays on some of its flights out of Copenhagen during the day, due to strike action by ground staff.
"We are expecting delays of up to one hour maximum but there will be no cancellations," SAS spokesman Jens Peter Skaarup told Reuters.

Check-in, ticket sales and other ancilliary workers have been staging sporadic stoppages since Monday, in protest against a management reprimand against their union chairman, for allegedly entering a training class without authorisation.

Skaarup said that senior staff were standing in for the approximately 200 strikers, out of a normal shift strength of 500, and the dispute was going to arbitration in the labour court later on Thursday.
SAS, which suffered repeated waves of strikes throughout Scandinavia last year, said that the current stoppages were limited to Copenhagen. --Christopher Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969652
